title: Listen and Choose a Response — Neighbors

questions.stem: Where's the closest laundromat to our building?

options.A: It opens at seven every morning.
options.B: Yes, I do my laundry on Sundays.
options.C: Our building was built in the 1980s.
options.D: There's one on Fifth Avenue, next to the bakery.

questions.explanation: A 'where' question is answered with a location. The others answer when, use Yes to a wh-question, or repeat 'building'.
